messages:
lucy: Auditor asked for a compact proof package showing the OPA RBAC policy change produced decision logs and corresponding KMS key metadata. Im collecting PR diff, deployed bundle manifest, decision-log slice, KMS audit events, and a signed manifest for chain-of-custody.
owen: Time window? full rollout or a sample?
auditor_claire: Sampling is fine as long as its reproducible: PR + commit hash, bundle.json, decision logs that show before/after behavior, KMS events tied to request IDs, and a signed manifest with checksum. Also need control mapping (SOC2 CC6 / ISO A.9) linking artifacts to controls.
lucy: Plan: 1) PR link + commit hash 2) bundle.json (bundle version) 3) opa_decisions.ndjson slice 4) kms_events.ndjson 5) mapping.md 6) manifest.json + manifest.sig + manifest.sha256 + verify_instructions.txt. Will include exact commands used to extract slices.
owen: Deployment window from CI: deploy job 20250318-09:15, bundle deployed 2025-03-18T09:12:00Z -> 2025-03-18T09:40:00Z. Ill pull logs with +/-5m padding.
lucy: Commands I will run (for transparency):
```n# OPA decision logs
gcloud logging read "resource.type=gae_app AND protoPayload.methodName=\\\"/v1/data/decision-logs\\\" AND timestamp>=\\\"2025-03-18T09:07:00Z\\\" AND timestamp<=\\\"2025-03-18T09:45:00Z\\\"" --format=json > /tmp/opa_decisions.ndjson

# KMS access events (CloudAuditLogs)
gcloud logging read "protoPayload.serviceName=kms.googleapis.com AND timestamp>=\\\"2025-03-18T09:07:00Z\\\" AND timestamp<=\\\"2025-03-18T09:45:00Z\\\"" --format=json > /tmp/kms_events.ndjson

# Create verification checksum
sha256sum manifest.json > manifest.sha256
```
(Will include these exact command outputs in package)
owen: For correlating: use jq to extract decision_context.request_id and policy_name, then match request_id to KMS log entry IDs. Example filter: `jq -c 'select(.decision_context.request_id!=null) | {ts:.timestamp,req:.decision_context.request_id,policy:.policy_name,result:.result}' /tmp/opa_decisions.ndjson > /tmp/opa_slice.ndjson`
security-bot: Reminder: key redaction policy is active; CloudAuditLogs will not contain plaintext crypto material. Provide key resource names, methods, caller identity and log entry IDs only.
auditor_claire: Thats acceptable. We need metadata to trace calls and a short narrative mapping file that ties artifacts to controls. Also include instructions to verify cosign signature and sha256.
lucy: Will use cosign for signing manifest.json. Example steps included:
```ncosign sign-blob -key /secrets/release.cosign < manifest.json > manifest.sig
aws s3 cp manifest.json s3://redwood-audit/2025-03-18/manifest.json
aws s3 cp manifest.sig s3://redwood-audit/2025-03-18/manifest.sig
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-audit/2025-03-18/manifest.json --expires-in 86400
```
and verify steps in verify_instructions.txt: `sha256sum -c manifest.sha256` and `cosign verify-blob -key cosign.pub --signature manifest.sig manifest.json`.
samir: Note: open vuln CVE-2025-1234 in dependency scan; its unrelated to this RBAC change but include a vulnerability inventory snapshot dated 2025-03-18 and mitigation status in mapping.md as a footnote.
owen: One concrete example: OPA decision logs show request_id=abcd-1234 at 2025-03-18T09:20:11Z which exercised the new allow rule for apps/frontend service accounts. Ill tag that entry and include it as "example 1" in mapping.md.
lucy: Ill assemble audit_package_2025-03-18.zip containing: PR_link.txt, bundle.json, opa_slice.ndjson, kms_events.ndjson, mapping.md, manifest.json, manifest.sig, manifest.sha256, verify_instructions.txt. Then upload and share presigned URLs.
auditor_claire: Also include CI run id and approve metadata for chain-of-custody: ci/4829, deploy job 20250318-09:15, approver: owen.
lucy: Adding that. ETA: upload + presigned links by EOD PST 2025-03-18 (23:00 PST). Will post here when done and include short verification note: how to match request_id across opa_slice and kms_events using entry logName and insertId.
owen: ACK. Ill verify no PII or secrets in slices and check redaction markers.
auditor_claire: Thanks, that timeline works. If you can show the exact verification commands and a short narrative of control mapping it will make our review faster.
lucy: Will do, thanks all :thumbsup:
